messages:
maria: Customer (AcmePayments) escalated — streaming responses cut off mid-sentence when traffic goes through Cloudflare -> ALB -> nginx. They get a final partial token then client reconnects repeatedly. Started yesterday afternoon.

alex: Can you paste the root request id + sample logs? Is Cloudflare proxying or using a Worker? Any intermediate proxies?

maria: req: req_0a1b2c3d. Flow: client -> Cloudflare CDN (fronting) -> ALB -> nginx (app) -> our runtime. Client reports `ERR_STREAM_RESET` and then reconnects. On the server we see 200 OK but the SSE stream stops emitting.

sam: I reproduced locally by putting Cloudflare in front of our staging ALB. Repro with curl below.

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \ 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  "https://staging.api.acme/v1/streams/chat?model=test"
```
\nBehavior: stream yields chunks for ~45-60s, then a partial chunk and connection closes. `tcpdump` shows FIN coming from ALB at ~61s after last byte.

jade: ALB default idle timeout = 60s. If no bytes cross the ALB for that window ALB will close. Why would there be no bytes? We send periodic heartbeats from runtime (roughly every 30s). Possible that Cloudflare or nginx are buffering and swallowing these heartbeats. Cloudflare's CDN and some proxy layers will coalesce small writes.

alex: Also check nginx settings: `proxy_buffering` and `proxy_read_timeout` matter. If nginx buffers upstream until buffer fills it won't flush SSE frames downstream. For streaming, `proxy_buffering off;` is usually required.

maria: Customer checked — nginx had `proxy_buffering on` and default buffer sizes. They toggled `proxy_buffering off` and immediately saw tokens stream continuously for a while, but ALB still closed some sessions at ~61s occasionally.

jade: Two-pronged mitigation:
- Increase ALB idle timeout to 120–300s for streaming endpoints (recommended 180s).
- Ensure non-empty SSE heartbeats so intermediate proxies flush. Empty comments (`\n`) sometimes get dropped; use `:ping \n\n` or `data: \n\n` or send a single-space data blob.

alex: Quick troubleshooting checklist for support to give customers:
1) Reproduce with `curl --no-buffer -N` (explicitly disables stdio buffering).
2) Run `tcpdump -i eth0 host <client-ip>` to confirm who sent FIN/RST.
3) Check ALB idle timeout (EC2 console / terraform setting).
4) Check nginx: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_send_timeout 300s; proxy_read_timeout 300s;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;`.
5) If Cloudflare is in front, try bypassing it temporarily or use a page rule that disables caching and buffering for the SSE route.

sam: We gave the customer exact nginx snippet and asked to bump ALB. They applied `proxy_buffering off` and our runtime switched to sending `:ping \n\n` heartbeats every 20s as a temporary workaround. After they bumped ALB idle timeout to 180s streams were stable for 2+ hours.

alex: Example nginx patch we recommended (snippet):
```
location /v1/streams/ {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_read_timeout 300s;
}
```

jade: For Envoy users, ensure `flush_interval` is set appropriately and `idle_timeout` on the upstream cluster is long enough. For Cloudflare, there is limited control; Workers can rebuffer, and their CDN might coalesce writes. Recommend bypassing CF for long-lived SSE or use the Spectrum/Tunnel product if needed.

maria: Customer applied our steps. Temporary fix = `proxy_buffering off` + non-empty heartbeat + ALB timeout 180s. They confirmed tokens streaming normally and no more mid-sentence truncations.

alex: Follow ups:
- Add KB article with exact config snippets for nginx/Envoy/ALB/Cloudflare and recommended defaults (ALB >= 120s; heartbeat <= 20s).
- Add an observability signal to detect EOFs caused by intermediate proxies vs client closed (heuristic: FIN from proxy IP within X ms of last server write). Add header `x-conn-closed-by: proxy|client|server` for easier triage.
